quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia press release: Nokia to sell Enterprise Campus Edge business to AURELIUS (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nokia signed a definitive agreement for the proposed acquisition by AURELIUS of its Enterprise Campus Edge (ECE) business (private wireless, industrial devices, on-premises operational technology (OT) edge and micro-edge solutions, and software applications that enable industrial AI-powered use cases); ECE serves nearly 900 customers across manufacturing, mining, logistics, airports, ports and power generation. The planned transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals, with ECE employees expected to transfer with the business. Chief Corporate Development Officer Konstanty Owczarek: the deal supports Nokia's strategy to 'sharpen its portfolio and direct capital and resources to the areas where it can create the greatest long-term value'.
quarterly_data.figure: ECE serves nearly 900 customers; closing expected in the first half of 2027
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: buyer of the Enterprise Campus Edge business
